QUICK MEMORY REVISION
Recall the concepts

1. Inline, internal and external CSS
External = reusable file.

2. Selectors and combinators
Space = any depth; > = one level.

3. Specificity, cascade and inheritance
Cascade decides; inheritance passes down.

4. Box model
Inside to outside: C-P-B-M.

5. Margin vs padding
Margin = outside; padding = inside.

6. Border and box-sizing
border-box = width includes border and padding.

7. Display: block, inline, inline-block, none
Block = line; inline-block = sized inline box.

8. Visibility vs display
Hidden = gap; none = no gap.

9. Units: px, %, em, rem, vw, vh
rem = root; vw/vh = viewport.

10. Colors and typography
Font size = size; line-height = line spacing.

11. Width, height, min/max
min = floor; max = ceiling.

14. Position: static, relative, absolute, fixed,
sticky
Relative parent anchors absolute child.

15. z-index and stacking context
Compare contexts before child z-index.

16. Pseudo-classes and pseudo-elements
Single colon state; double colon part (modern
syntax).

19. !important
Important is priority, not a specificity score.
